sourceLevelExclusionGuarantee.claim: no model turn can occur on the refused path
sourceLevelExclusionGuarantee.mechanism: in runWorker the order is: agents.create -> capabilityRefusal check (throws + disposes) -> handle.agent -> agent.followup. The capability refusal throws BEFORE the only agent.followup call in the block, so on a refusal the first turn is unreachable.

runtimeMeasurement.observation: turn/start, turn/end and request/header events in the written session = 0
runtimeMeasurement.interpretation: a model turn appends these events; zero of them shows no turn was appended

explicitNonReliance: the claim does NOT rest on an absent provider or a failed request: a failed network call would still be an attempted request. No provider is contacted at all because no turn exists.
